content: Qwen via Alibaba Cloud DashScope OpenAI-compatible mode. Base URL varies by region: intl https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, China https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, US https://dashscope-us.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. Chat endpoint POST {base}/chat/completions. Auth via DASHSCOPE_API_KEY as Bearer token (OpenAI-compatible mode). Models: qwen3-max, qwen3-max-preview, qwen-plus-<date> snapshots, qwen-turbo, qwen-coder, qwen-vl (vision, out of scope).
